claims.excerpt: How the SOFAR Channel Carries Whale Calls Across the Ocean
claims.claim: The SOFAR channel carries whale calls across the ocean.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: In some instances low-frequency sounds carry across entire ocean basins. Hydrophones at the channel's axis can detect faraway sounds, including whale calls.
claims.narrative: The central idea is that this channel’s sound-carrying behavior makes faraway whale calls audible to hydrophones.
claims.explanation: The title links whale calls specifically to ocean-scale transmission. The evidence supports basin-scale travel for low-frequency sounds generally and separately says hydrophones can detect faraway sounds including whale calls; it does not establish that whale calls travel across the ocean.
claims.materiality: The title materially expands the stated scale and scope of whale-call transmission.
